_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "kv" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("key"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "folders" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "owner_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "parent_id" TEXT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "name_norm" TEXT NOT NULL, "color_argb" INTEGER NULL, "icon" TEXT NULL, "sort_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "trash_root_id" TEXT NULL, "version" TEXT NOT NULL, "field_versions" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "notes" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "owner_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "folder_id" TEXT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "title_norm" TEXT NOT NULL, "cover_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "tags_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "is_favorite" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("is_favorite" IN (0, 1)), "sort_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "schema_version" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "trash_root_id" TEXT NULL, "version" TEXT NOT NULL, "field_versions" TEXT NULL, "page_count" INTEGER NOT NULL, "first_page_id" TEXT NULL, "last_opened_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "pages" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "note_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "sort_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "width" REAL NOT NULL, "height" REAL NOT NULL, "background_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "version" TEXT NOT NULL, "field_versions" TEXT NULL, "content_rev" INTEGER NOT NULL, "ink_rev" TEXT NULL, "ink_rev_at" INTEGER NULL, "bg_asset_id" TEXT NULL, "bg_pdf_index" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "strokes" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "page_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "note_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "tool" TEXT NOT NULL, "color_argb" INTEGER NOT NULL, "width" REAL NOT NULL, "opacity" REAL NOT NULL, "pressure_sensitivity" REAL NOT NULL, "pressure_curve" TEXT NOT NULL, "smoothing" REAL NOT NULL, "style_extras_json" TEXT NULL, "points" BLOB NOT NULL, "point_count" INTEGER NOT NULL, "min_x" REAL NOT NULL, "min_y" REAL NOT NULL, "max_x" REAL NOT NULL, "max_y" REAL NOT NULL, "recording_id" TEXT NULL, "recording_offset_ms" INTEGER NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "version" TEXT NOT NULL, "field_versions" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "pen_presets" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "owner_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "style_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "group_name" TEXT NULL, "pinned" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("pinned" IN (0, 1)), "sort_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "version" TEXT NOT NULL, "field_versions" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "assets" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "owner_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "mime_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "size" INTEGER NOT NULL, "file_name" TEXT NULL, "chunk_count" INTEGER NOT NULL, "has_local_bytes" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("has_local_bytes" IN (0, 1)), "storage_path" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "version" TEXT NOT NULL, "field_versions" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "recordings" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "note_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "asset_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "duration_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "started_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "version" TEXT NOT NULL, "field_versions" TEXT NULL, "title" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "settings" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "version" TEXT NOT NULL, "field_versions" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("key"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "outbox" ("seq" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "rev" INTEGER NOT NULL, "entity_kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "note_id" TEXT NULL, "page_id" TEXT NULL, "op" TEXT NOT NULL, "changed_fields" TEXT NOT NULL, "hlc" TEXT NOT NULL, "enqueued_at" INTEGER NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "page_objects" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "page_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "note_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "min_x" REAL NOT NULL, "min_y" REAL NOT NULL, "max_x" REAL NOT NULL, "max_y" REAL NOT NULL, "data_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "asset_id" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "version" TEXT NOT NULL, "field_versions" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "handwriting" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "page_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "note_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "engine_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "source_rev" TEXT NOT NULL, "lines_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "version" TEXT NOT NULL, "field_versions" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "recording_drafts" ("draft_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "recording_id" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "note_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "mime_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "started_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "chunk_count" INTEGER NOT NULL, "bytes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "active_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("draft_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "search_owners" ("source" TEXT NOT NULL, "owner_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "note_id" TEXT NULL, "page_id" TEXT NULL, "source_rev" TEXT NOT NULL, "pending" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("pending" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("source", "owner_key"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "search_units" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL, "owner_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "seq" INTEGER NOT NULL, "note_id" TEXT NULL, "page_id" TEXT NULL, "asset_id" TEXT NULL, "pdf_index" INTEGER NULL, "body" TEXT NOT NULL, "norm" TEXT NOT NULL, "rect_l" REAL NULL, "rect_t" REAL NULL, "rect_r" REAL NULL, "rect_b" REAL NULL, "rects_ref" TEXT NULL, "pdf_aspect" REAL NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("source", "owner_key", "seq"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "md_docs" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "note_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "text" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "version" TEXT NOT NULL, "field_versions" TEXT NULL, "text_bytes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "base_text_version" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE INDEX idx_folders_parent ON folders (owner_id, parent_id, deleted_at)
CREATE INDEX idx_folders_trash ON folders (trash_root_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_notes_folder ON notes (owner_id, folder_id, deleted_at)
CREATE INDEX idx_notes_opened ON notes (owner_id, last_opened_at)
CREATE INDEX idx_notes_favorite ON notes (owner_id, is_favorite, deleted_at)
CREATE INDEX idx_notes_trash ON notes (trash_root_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_pages_note ON pages (note_id, deleted_at, sort_key)
CREATE INDEX idx_pages_bg ON pages (bg_asset_id, bg_pdf_index)
CREATE INDEX idx_strokes_page ON strokes (page_id, deleted_at)
CREATE INDEX idx_strokes_note ON strokes (note_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_strokes_recording ON strokes (recording_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_recordings_note ON recordings (note_id, deleted_at)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_outbox_entity ON outbox (entity_kind, entity_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_objects_page ON page_objects (page_id, deleted_at)
CREATE INDEX idx_objects_note ON page_objects (note_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_objects_asset ON page_objects (asset_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_handwriting_note ON handwriting (note_id, deleted_at)
CREATE INDEX idx_drafts_note ON recording_drafts (note_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_search_owners_note ON search_owners (note_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_search_owners_pending ON search_owners (pending)
CREATE INDEX idx_search_units_note ON search_units (note_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_search_units_pdf ON search_units (asset_id, pdf_index)
CREATE INDEX idx_md_note ON md_docs (note_id)
